description: An original PDF scanner for Android: capture pages with the camera, rotate and apply grayscale, draw a signature, and export a multi-page PDF. Built as a clean-room rebuild, not a copy of any existing scanner app.
name: DocScan

description: Four playable puzzle modes — a Queens-style grid, a Tango-style symbol grid, a Zip-style path puzzle and an original word-association game — with daily challenges seeded by date, free play, hints, undo, scoring and local achievements.
name: PuzzleVerse

description: A home-cooked food site with a homepage, searchable catalog with filters, blog detail pages, WhatsApp order links and a simulated AI chatbox. Data is kept in JSON behind one isolated data layer, so it can move to an API later.
name: Sensei Homemade

description: A sample warehouse API design: stock movements, low-stock alerts and simple audit history, with clear request/response shapes and tests for the core inventory rules. Sample project — replace the details with your real implementation.
name: Warehouse Stock API

description: A sample mini commerce system outline: products, orders and event-driven updates, structured so each module can be read and tested on its own. Sample project — the public repository is a starting point, not a finished product claim.
name: Mini Commerce System
